title: A clearer Whether
question: Choose the structure to carry forward. These are visual mockups using the captured Nov 16 brief; no production UI has changed.

options.label: Focused workspace
options.thesis: Choose an operating area and read its action and lines in one focused view.
options.viewport: A slim navigation rail, a compact weekly call, five area rows, and a selected-area detail panel.
options.risk: Fast for one decision; the other areas’ full rules require selection.

options.label: Decision table
options.thesis: Compare all five actions and their pause and restart lines without scrolling through repeated cards.
options.viewport: A compact top navigation, short blue weekly summary, and one full-width table with action and threshold columns.
options.risk: The densest option; phone layouts must turn each row into a readable vertical group.

options.label: One-page brief
options.thesis: Read the weekly call and five actions as one concise, shareable brief.
options.viewport: Top navigation, one reading column with a compact blue call, five flat action rows, and a quiet evidence rail.
options.risk: The clearest reading flow, with less room for detailed evidence in the opening screen.
